activeWarning.title: HIGH HEAT STRESS WARNING

activeWarning.why: Contributing factors: Ambient temp (36°C), low atmospheric humidity (35%), and direct solar flux (880 W/m²).
activeWarning.whatToDo: Hydrate frequently, restrict strenuous outdoor labor during peak sunshine, ensure livestock ventilation, and monitor vulnerable individuals.
activeWarning.isOfficialGuidanceDistinction: NOTICE: This is an analytical climate risk assessment generated by ClimateShield algorithms. In emergency situations, always follow directives from local meteorological and disaster management authorities.

activeWarning.title: HIGH PROLONGED DROUGHT & MOISTURE DEFICIT ADVISORY
activeWarning.what: Soil desiccation and severe agricultural moisture deficiency.
activeWarning.when: Developing over past 14 days and projected to intensify through the week.
activeWarning.why: Contributing factors: Precipitation anomaly (-97%), volumetric soil moisture at 23%, and vegetation NDVI down to 0.53.
activeWarning.whatToDo: Implement soil moisture conservation measures, activate secondary storage tanks, and follow regional water usage quotas.
activeWarning.isOfficialGuidanceDistinction: NOTICE: This is an analytical climate risk assessment generated by ClimateShield algorithms. In emergency situations, always follow directives from local meteorological and disaster management authorities.

activeWarning.title: EXTREME PROLONGED DROUGHT & MOISTURE DEFICIT ADVISORY
activeWarning.what: Soil desiccation and severe agricultural moisture deficiency.
activeWarning.when: Developing over past 14 days and projected to intensify through the week.
activeWarning.why: Contributing factors: Precipitation anomaly (-82%), volumetric soil moisture at 12%, and vegetation NDVI down to 0.42.
activeWarning.whatToDo: Implement soil moisture conservation measures, activate secondary storage tanks, and follow regional water usage quotas.
activeWarning.isOfficialGuidanceDistinction: NOTICE: This is an analytical climate risk assessment generated by ClimateShield algorithms. In emergency situations, always follow directives from local meteorological and disaster management authorities.

alerts.title: HIGH: Agricultural Drought Watch
alerts.message: Elevated surface heat and thermal stress index (37.5°C).
alerts.expectedTime: Expected to peak between 12:00 PM and 5:00 PM over the next 48-72 hours.
recommendations: Shift irrigation to nocturnal hours (8:00 PM – 5:00 AM) - Reduces daytime evapotranspiration loss by up to 35% and prevents thermal shock on crops.
Deploy crop residue mulching and prioritize deficit drip irrigation - Topsoil moisture is at 29%. Mulching preserves sub-surface moisture retention for 5-8 days.

alerts.title: 🚨 DEMO SCENARIO: HIGH FLOOD RISK WARNING
alerts.message: SIMULATION DEMO: Torrential precipitation influx combined with saturated soil conditions and lowland basin drainage constraints.
factors: Heavy rainfall forecast (74 mm in next 24h)
Local basin terrain characteristics (Impeded drainage gradient)
recommendations: Monitor local official weather advisories and emergency management bulletins.
Avoid unnecessary travel through flood-prone lowlands and underpasses.
Elevate and protect vital equipment, farm implements, and documents.
Strictly comply with directives from local civil defense and disaster response authorities.

alerts.title: Elevated Heat Stress Warning
alerts.message: Afternoon surface temperatures forecasted to reach 41.5°C with high solar radiation. Moisture evaporation rate elevated.
recommendations: Shift irrigation cycles to late evening or pre-dawn to minimize evapotranspiration losses.
Schedule farm hand and outdoor worker physical activities prior to 10:30 AM.
Provide shade and abundant water for livestock.

alerts.title: Early Drought Watch Indicator
alerts.message: Consecutive dry spell of 14 days detected with topsoil moisture dropping below 18%.
recommendations: Implement soil mulching to conserve root zone moisture.
Monitor groundwater extraction limits and prepare supplemental drip reservoirs.
